title: Bad Hair Day?
description: BAD HAIR DAY? Jabba the Hutt seems unhappy in these developmental sketches byJoe Johnston. Actually, George Lucas had a second chance with Jabba, who as a humanoid in a scene that was cut from STAR WARS. For RETURN OF THE JEDI, the artists started out again with a human form, but with jowly, sagging flesh and a drooping chin that completely hid any neck. Once centipede-like legs were eliminated, Jabba the slug was born
